# Workforce Optimization

Your dispatchers approve the plan instead of building it.

Re-plan technician zones and daily routes on your own field-service data, and
hand the dispatcher a plan to approve instead of a blank grid.

## Who it is for

Field-service operations leaders at companies running Oracle Fusion Field
Service with 200+ technicians.

## What changes

Planning cycle time drops from ~2 days of manual work to ~30 min.
Illustrative proof-of-value result, not contractual.

## How to start

**PoV Jumpstart** — 4–8 weeks on your own data, in a separate environment.
Services from €90K*, infrastructure about €2K* a month.
*Indicative; the scope is confirmed at kickoff.

**Integration** and **Scaling** follow the proof of value; both are scoped per
engagement.

Built on OCI GPU Instances, with the plan written back to Oracle Fusion Field
Service. Talk to us: oracle@softserveinc.com.
